tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the product catalogue. Use broad keywords first (e.g., "shoes" not "red nike running shoes"). If total_matched is high, use filters or add keywords. Always use this to find SKUs before calling get_product.

query.description: Keywords to match against product title and description.

category_ids.description: Restrict to one or more category IDs returned by list_categories. Matches products in ANY of the provided categories.

offset.description: Pagination offset. Use to fetch the next page of results if total_matched > returned.

brand_ids.description: Restrict to one or more brand IDs returned by list_brands. Matches products of ANY of the given brands. Combine with category_ids for a brand-in-category search — e.g. Canon within Digital Cameras.

in_stock.description: When true, return only products currently in stock. Omit for no stock restriction. Has no effect on second-hand searches, which only ever list in-stock items.

search_second_hand.description: When true, search our second-hand products for sale. Omit for searching our new products.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Retrieve deep details, exact stock availability, and variations for a specific product using its SKU.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: The category tree. Use this first to learn the exact vocabulary and IDs this store uses before searching.

tools.name: list_brands
tools.description: The brands this store carries. Use this first to learn valid brand IDs before filtering search_products by brand_ids.
